column1: # Cases of the runner self-test: a row (verdict exit key line col) and what a compiler did (rc, image written, stderr with \n for a line feed,
# exit status of the image), and ok = whether the row's verdict holds. The self-test judges each case with judge_row.
admit no image, no exit asked
refuse line on other stderr line
refuse key glued to a word
refuse key absent, no line asked
refuse line word glued to a word
refuse line and column words ok
refuse line and col words ok
refuse line and column words of column 90
